license_required.quote: A person may not establish, operate, or maintain a commercial or public junk yard without a certificate of location prescribed by AS 08.60.050 - 08.60.100.

issuing_authority.value: commissioner of public safety / city council / organized borough assembly
issuing_authority.quote: If the location is in a city of any class, the certificate shall be procured from the city council or its designee. If the location is outside the city limits but within the boundaries of an organized borough, the certificate shall be procured from the assembly of the organized borough or its designee. If the location is outside an incorporated city or borough, the certificate of location shall be obtained from the commissioner of public safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating, establishing, or maintaining a junk yard without procuring a certificate of approval.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who operates, establishes, or maintains a junk yard in any location without procuring a certificate of approval is guilty of a misdemeanor

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The commissioner of public safety or the cities or organized boroughs shall examine the location or proposed location of a junk yard and adopt reasonable regulations concerning the establishment, operation, and maintenance of businesses under the standards set out in AS 08.60.070.

definition_quote.value: "junk" means any secondhand and used machinery, scrap iron, copper, lead, zinc, aluminum, or other metals; it also includes wrecked automobiles, tools, implements, rags, used building materials, rubber, and paper
definition_quote.quote: "junk" means any secondhand and used machinery, scrap iron, copper, lead, zinc, aluminum, or other metals; it also includes wrecked automobiles, tools, implements, rags, used building materials, rubber, and paper

transaction_record_format.quote: A scrap metal dealer shall maintain an accurate paper or electronic record of each in-person transaction

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: A dealer shall maintain the records of a transaction required by AS 08.60.200 and 08.60.210 for five years after the date of the transaction.

seller_vehicle_info_required.quote: a description, including the license plate information, of a motor vehicle used to deliver the scrap metal to the dealer

seller_ownership_statement_required.quote: A scrap metal dealer shall require a person from whom the dealer is purchasing scrap metal for $100 or more to sign a written or electronic statement that the scrap metal is not stolen property.

physical_location_screening_standards.quote: the commissioner of public safety, the city council, and organized borough assembly, in considering applications and regulations, shall take into account (1) the nature and development of surrounding property; (2) the need to protect the local economy, adjacent land owners, and the motoring public from economically depressing and unsightly roadside locations; (3) the proximity of churches, schools, hospitals, public buildings, recreation areas, or other places of public gathering; (4) the sufficiency in number of other similar business establishments in the vicinity; (5) the adequacy of fences and other types of enclosures to prevent the unsightly display of a junk yard; (6) the health, safety, and general welfare of the public; (7) the suitability of the applicant to establish, maintain, or operate the business under AS 08.60.050 - 08.60.100.

fencing_or_screening_required.quote: The regulations may require the erection, location, and size of fences or other structures surrounding the junk yard.

pawnbroker_interest_rate_cap.value: 20 percent of the amount financed per 30-day period, or $5, whichever is greater
pawnbroker_interest_rate_cap.quote: a pawnbroker may charge a pledgor a finance fee of $5 or an amount that equals interest at a rate that does not exceed 20 percent of the amount financed, whichever amount is greater

pawnbroker_minimum_loan_term_days.quote: the pawnbroker shall hold the pledged property on the pawnbroker's business premises for a grace period of 30 days plus any extension allowed under AS 08.76.250

criminal_history_lookback_years.quote: A pawnbroker may not knowingly employ a person to work in a pawnshop if, within five years before the employment begins, the person was convicted of, entered a plea of guilty to, entered a plea of no contest to, or had adjudication withheld for a felony or for a misdemeanor involving dishonesty.

employee_criminal_history_restrictions.quote: A pawnbroker may not knowingly employ a person to work in a pawnshop if, within five years before the employment begins, the person was convicted of, entered a plea of guilty to, entered a plea of no contest to, or had adjudication withheld for a felony or for a misdemeanor involving dishonesty.

value: persons who maintain on file with the dealer their name, address, telephone number, and a taxpayer identification number issued by the IRS or a valid government-issued photo identification card
exempt_seller_categories.quote: The requirements of AS 08.60.200 and 08.60.210 do not apply to a person's transactions with a dealer if the person maintains on file with the dealer the name, address, and telephone number of the person, and a taxpayer identification number issued by the federal Internal Revenue Service or a valid government-issued photo identification card.

restricted_regulated_metals_list.quote: "scrap metal" means used, discarded, or previously owned brass, copper, bronze, aluminum, lead, stainless steel, catalytic converter material, or other metal
